title: Nice towels. Not worth $13 for only 4
text:
Nice towels. Not worth $13 for only 4. These dish towels are nice. They are a good size. I love the gray color.

The reason for 3 stars is because I don't think $13 for 4 towels is a good deal for these towels. They are nice enough but I don't think they are worth that much. I would pay $8 at the most for these.

product_metadata.title: DII Basic Chef Collection, Assorted Terry Kitchen Towel Set, Dishcloth Set, Gray, 6 Piece
features: PERFECT TOWELS TO TACKLE ANY JOB: Set of 6 dishcloths measures 12x12-inches to tackle all of your drying, wiping and cleaning kitchen tasks
QUALITY ASSURANCEL: Ultra-absorbent 100% cotton fabric with a tight knit loop with become more absorbent with each wash
AFFORDABLE LUXARY: Light weight & tightly woven cloths are a wonderful addition to any kitchen

MACHINE WASHABLE: Wash in cold water; DO NOT use bleach, Do not use fabric softener (coats fibers causing fabric to become less absorbent), dry towels on tumble cycle to minimize shrinkage, may be ironed with low heat
MORE FROM DII: We offer other great dishtowel options including an assortment of aprons, tablecloths, ceramics, and storage
description: Tackle kitchen messes with DII Terry chef dishcloths and dishtowels. Use for your everyday kitchen needs from washing dishes, dusting, or cleaning grime and crumbs off countertops. These sets are great for a new home or apartment. These essentials are made of 100% cotton with a classic design that coordinates with most kitchen decor becoming more absorbent with each wash. Towels air dry quickly and are ready to use again in no time. Quality you can rely on, cloths are made with high quality cotton with a tight knit to allow for less lint on your glass or plates. Wash before first use. Dish cloths will lose any lint remaining from the weaving process, and will become softer and more absorbent after washing: Wash in cold water; DO NOT use bleach, Do not use fabric softener (coats fibers causing fabric to become less absorbent), dry towels on tumble cycle to minimize shrinkage, may be ironed with low heat.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors. Tumble dry low. Warm iron if needed.
